reuse.why: Calls the existing exported getScheduledAmount from #shared/schedules, the same helper forecast, schedule templates and previews already use, with the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the range/number/missing rule stays in the one shared helper.

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API mapping layer; the only wart is that expectedAmount is added as an optional field to APIScheduleEntity, which also serves as the input shape for creating schedules.

scope.why: One import, one type field, one mapping line and a focused test.

maintainability.why: A one-line derivation through the shared helper; any future change to the expected-amount rule reaches the API automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduledAmount rather than re-deriving the range endpoint.
